prompts.sewer: Edit target is the attached sewer terrain crop. This is production 16-bit top-down vertically scrolling shoot-em-up terrain, not concept illustration. Preserve the exact camera, pixel texture, muted olive/brown/rusted metal palette, width and layout. Replace the entire large circular alien portal and organic red arch at the top with a straight continuation of the same industrial sewer corridor below: continuous central dirty concrete flight lane, matching pipes and grates along left and right, same floor widths and same channels. The corridor must run unobstructed all the way to the top edge; no portal, circle, arch, text, characters, objects crossing the center. Preserve the bottom half of the reference exactly, including all its grates, floor cracks, side pipe outlines and alpha channel holes; the bottom edge must connect precisely to the existing original terrain. Upper floor and side pipes should feel like the lower floor simply continues upstream. Genuine transparent background in all open side water channels, which will get animated sludge in the game. A quiet repeating stretch of industrial sewer, very detailed but authentically pixel art. Output a single vertical terrain image in the same aspect ratio as reference, no sheet borders.
prompts.lamprey: Production asset repair. Reference is the existing armored lamprey enemy from Bullets of Fury. Regenerate this exact top-down purple-black biomechanical armored lamprey with gold rivets and panels, curled tail behind its head, wing-like organic armored fins, menacing toothed downward-facing round maw at the southern tip. Keep the 16-bit pixel art detailing and palette. The reference has its bottom mouth CUT OFF by the canvas edge; repair that mistake. Show the ENTIRE creature including every tooth and the complete mouth, fins and curled tail, with generous transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides. One centered sprite, full silhouette, strict overhead game camera, head points vertically SOUTH at the player. No exterior ground, no shadow plate, no UI, no words, no adjacent creatures. Transparent background, no glow aura. Do not crop anything. Maintain the proportions, visual identity and existing design. The whole animal should occupy around 75% of the square canvas.
prompts.boss: Reference is the existing alien vessel for Bullets of Fury's Stage 8 boss. Create its MUTATED first combat form as one complete centered sprite on transparent background, strict top-down view, facing vertically south toward the player. Maintain the recognizable black biomechanical hull silhouette, curled upper tendrils, central purple slit core and two lateral cyan cannon pods. Mutation: grown black chitin armor ribs around the hull, menacing segmented hooked tendrils wrapping its flanks without covering cannon tips, central core split into a bright violet eye/maw with crystalline teeth, cyan binary 0/1 runic lights embedded sparsely into dark hull panels. Two distinct downward-facing heavy side cannon pods remain clearly readable as independently destructible hardware, at the same relative positions as reference. Fierce alien symbiote warship, sophisticated highly detailed 16-bit pixel art in the game's existing style. No background, no ground, no external aura, no circles outside the ship, no missiles in flight, no firing beams, no text label, no border, no other sprites. Full silhouette and all appendages within canvas with 8% padding on every side. This is a shipping game boss sprite, not an illustration. One sprite only.
